skill.name: app-builder
skill.description: Orchestrates application planning and scaffolding from natural language. It detects project type, selects a template, suggests a stack, and coordinates specialist coding agents.
skill.summary: Plan and scaffold full-stack applications with template-guided agent coordination.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All static findings are documentation false positives in Markdown tables, sample directory trees, setup notes, or environment variable placeholder lists. No evidence was found for prompt injection, credential exfiltration, hidden network calls, or actual command execution in the cited files. The author should clarify consent around dependency installation and real secret handling in generated projects.

remediation.issue: Environment examples mention .env.local and secret variable names.
remediation.suggestion: Document only .env.example placeholders and instruct users to add real values manually outside generated files.

remediation.issue: Template setup steps include package installation and development server commands.
remediation.suggestion: State that dependency installation and development server commands require explicit user approval before execution.

remediation.issue: Prompt-like wording such as ASK USER can confuse security scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Use neutral wording such as confirm the UI library with the user to reduce false prompt injection signals.

content.user_title: Build Full-Stack Apps from Natural Language
content.value_statement: Starting a new app often requires many architecture and tooling decisions. This skill turns a plain-language request into a template-guided plan, stack choice, and agent workflow.
actual_capabilities: Detects project type from request keywords and maps it to a matching template.
Recommends technology stacks for web, mobile, API, desktop, and command-line projects.
Defines directory structures for frameworks such as Next.js, Nuxt, FastAPI, Expo, and Turborepo.
Coordinates planning, frontend, backend, database, testing, security, and deployment agent phases.
Provides setup steps and best practices for each supported project template.
limitations: It does not replace project-specific architecture or security review.
It assumes users approve package installs, environment changes, and development server commands.
Generated plans need manual validation against current framework versions.
It does not provide production secrets or deploy infrastructure by itself.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Web Product
use_cases.description: Turn a product idea into a Next.js or Nuxt project plan with routes, data models, and setup steps.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Scaffolding
use_cases.description: Use repeatable templates and agent phases for new internal apps, APIs, and monorepos.

use_cases.title: Extend an Existing Project
use_cases.description: Analyze a feature request, identify frontend, backend, database, and configuration changes, and create an implementation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple App Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a project plan for a small task management app. Choose the best template, explain the stack, and list the first files to create.

prompt_templates.title: Scaffold a Full-Stack Product
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a full-stack dashboard for managing customers and invoices. Select the template, define the data model, plan routes, and coordinate the implementation phases.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Major Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Add subscription billing to this existing web app. Analyze required schema, API, UI, configuration, testing, and deployment changes before editing files.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Multi-Agent Build
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan and coordinate a SaaS MVP with authentication, billing, email, dashboard pages, tests, and preview deployment. Require checkpoints before each specialist phase starts.

output_examples.input: Make an Instagram-style photo sharing app.
output_examples.output: The skill selects a full-stack web template, proposes a social media data model, lists feed and profile pages, and separates implementation tasks.

output_examples.input: Create a FastAPI service for managing inventory.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends the FastAPI template and outlines routers, services, schemas, models, migrations, tests, and local setup steps.

output_examples.input: Add payments to my SaaS dashboard.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies subscription, checkout, webhook, environment, database, and billing portal work, then creates a phased change plan.

best_practices: Confirm product scope, target platform, and required integrations before scaffolding files.
Review generated environment placeholders and add real secrets manually through approved channels.
Run tests and security checks after template setup and before deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not run package installation commands without user approval.
Do not copy real secrets into generated templates or documentation.
Do not skip planning checkpoints for complex multi-agent builds.

faq.question: What kinds of apps can this skill help build?
faq.answer: It supports web apps, SaaS products, APIs, mobile apps, desktop apps, browser extensions, command-line tools, documentation sites, and monorepos.

faq.question: Does it create production-ready code automatically?
faq.answer: It creates plans, scaffold guidance, and implementation workflows. Production readiness still requires testing, review, configuration, and deployment validation.

faq.question: Which frameworks are covered?
faq.answer: Templates include Next.js, Nuxt, FastAPI, Express, Expo, Flutter, Electron, Chrome extensions, Astro, Turborepo, and Node command-line tooling.

faq.question: Can it work with an existing project?
faq.answer: Yes. It can analyze a feature request, identify required changes, and create a phased plan for adding the feature.

faq.question: Does it handle secrets?
faq.answer: It names expected environment variables. Users should provide real secret values only through approved local or deployment settings.

faq.question: Is it useful for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is marked as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
